corp_name_eng: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 7 Company

summary.headline: Mirae Asset Vision SPAC 7 to merge with Autohands via absorption; Autohands to list on KOSDAQ, Apr 28, 2027
summary.what_happened: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 7 Company, a KOSDAQ-listed SPAC, will be absorbed by unlisted Autohands Co., Ltd. through a merger, with Autohands as the surviving company, under a merger ratio of 1 : 0.2509636. The November 24, 2026 amendment (second correction) moved the key schedule dates later, including the shareholder vote to Mar 4, 2027 and the merger date to Apr 8, 2027.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korean SPAC mergers, shareholders of the listed SPAC typically receive or are converted into shares of the surviving private company, and those opposing the merger may have appraisal (share purchase claim) rights within a set window after the shareholder vote. Schedules such as record dates, trading suspensions and listing dates are often revised, as happened here, so the dates in the most recent filing are the ones to follow.
